integrity: Complete exact formulas, self-contained proof and standalone SymPy checker included; no external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to the paired-frequency squared-sinc product with arbitrary positive scales.
Originality comparisons are bounded; an equivalent earlier Bessel-product formulation may be unindexed.
There is no assertion about all distinct four-frequency products or interpolation condition numbers.
The analytic Abel obstruction is necessary for exclusion of dimension eight; finite experiments alone do not establish it.
title: Sharp seven-dimensional threshold for a two-scale squared-sinc kernel
